additionalDocuments.label: Ellington Claydon House official amenities plans

review.gallery: Nine developer renders from the Claydon House site and brochure. The official full-tower exterior is shared by the gallery lead and listing card.
review.location: The JRE project point agrees with the Ellington map near the E44 junction. Sixteen estimates reviewed visually. For Meydan Racecourse, the project page gives 15 minutes and the original map gives 10. The Metro marketing reference is excluded as an operational destination.
review.floorPlans: Forty-two complete original drawings: 21 unit layouts, 18 residential plates and three amenity sheets. The project brief matches the published floor groups but omits two study layouts included in the standalone plans. Visually reviewed unit titles, printed totals and level groupings. No 24th-floor plate appears in either of the two developer plan sets.

unavailable: Exact visitor entrance, current access to the referenced Metro line, a separate floor 24 drawing, retail unit layout sheets and contracted unit areas.
